# Zuza Prague Tours

> Private, certified Prague tour guide for German- and English-speaking visitors. Run by Ing. Zuzana Manova, guiding since 1986.

## About

Zuza Prague Tours is a one-person tour guide service based in Prague, Czech Republic. The guide is Ing. Zuzana Manova, who has been leading walking tours of Prague since 1986 (40+ years). She is not an agency; she personally guides every tour.

## Certifications

- Czech Republic certified tour guide (state license)
- Accredited by the Jewish Museum in Prague for Jewish Quarter tours
- University degree (Ing.)

## Languages

- German (fluent, primary client language)
- English (fluent)
- Czech (native)

## Tour types

- Prague Castle and Hradcany (3-4 hours)
- Old Town and Jewish Quarter (3-4 hours)
- Hidden Prague history tour (3-4 hours)
- German-language specialized tour (3-4 hours)
- Vaclav Havel and Velvet Revolution tour (3-4 hours)
- Custom and private tours (flexible duration)

All tours are private and tailored to the visitor's interests. No fixed groups, no bus tours.
